overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair could not reasonably have anticipated an anonymous letter received the day of the meeting, so its unlisted discussion was permitted, though the Council was reminded to postpone controversial unlisted topics.

allegations.summary: Council allegedly discussed a topic at its May 14 meeting (an anonymous letter about a resident's hydrant use) that was not listed on the meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: As the Council president could not have reasonably anticipated receipt of the letter just ahead of the meeting, we find that the Council did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
